{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify that all values are now numeric
all_numeric = pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(df['revenue_clean'])

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
df_filtered = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
total_mean = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Check number of such orders
n_orders = len(df_filtered)

all_numeric, total_mean, n_orders"}
